statusPage.pageDescription: Filter species by GoaT sequencing status (GoaT project pipeline) and target list priority. Pipeline counts are portal-wide; the table total follows your filters.
statusPage.registryDescription: Tab-separated GoaT-schema report for this portal: taxon ids, names, sequencing status, target list, and publication fields.
statusPage.pipelineHelp: Each stage shows how many species are in that GoaT sequencing status (whole portal). Tap a stage or target list chip to filter the table; hover the selection badges below for full descriptions.
statusPage.detailPickBody: Tap a stage card or bar segment to add or remove that sequencing status. Combine stages to match species in any of them. Use target list chips to narrow by listing priority.
statusPage.detailFilteredHint: The species list below matches this stage only.
statusPage.detailMultiBody: The list shows species whose GoaT status is any of these stages (OR).
statusPage.emptyBody: Try clearing filters or selecting different stages.
statusPage.exportDrawerDescription: Download every species that matches the current filters. Pagination does not apply.
statusPage.exportDrawerColumns: Columns scientific_name and taxid are always included.
